```{r}
rm(list=ls())
gc()
```

# Read in files
```{r}
megatable <- read.csv("../data/pangenome_project_megatable.csv")

strelka <- megatable[c("Donor_ID", "Reference", "Strelka_Precision", "Strelka_Recall", "Strelka_F1_Score")]
somatic <- megatable[c("Donor_ID", "Reference", "Somatic_Precision", "Somatic_Recall", "Somatic_F1_Score")]
mutect <- megatable[c("Donor_ID", "Reference", "Mutect_Precision", "Mutect_Recall", "Mutect_F1_Score")]

strelka$Variant_Caller <- "Strelka"
somatic$Variant_Caller <- "SomaticSniper"
mutect$Variant_Caller <- "Mutect2"
```

# Setup
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

colors <- c("#e5d9ff", "#f1a1ff", "#9c8fff")
black_colors <- c("black", "black", "black")
```

# Useful functions
```{r}
rename_col <- function(df) {
  colnames(df)[grepl("_Recall$", colnames(df))] <- "Recall"
  colnames(df)[grepl("_Precision$", colnames(df))] <- "Precision"
  colnames(df)[grepl("_F1_Score$", colnames(df))] <- "F1_Score"
  return(df)
}

as_numeric <- function(df) {
  df <- df[df$Reference %in% c("Pangenome", "Linear"), ]
  df$F1_Score <- as.numeric(df$F1_Score)
  df$Precision <- as.numeric(df$Precision)
  df$Recall <- as.numeric(df$Recall)
  return(df)
}

strelka <- rename_col(strelka)
somatic <- rename_col(somatic)
mutect <- rename_col(mutect)

strelka <- as_numeric(strelka)
somatic <- as_numeric(somatic)
mutect <- as_numeric(mutect)
```

# Calculate delta difference
```{r}
delta_diff <- function(data) {
  pan <- data[data$Reference == "Pangenome", ]
  lin  <- data[data$Reference == "Linear", ]
  
  merged <- merge(pan, lin, by = "Donor_ID", suffixes = c("_Pangenome", "_Linear"))
  
  result <- data.frame(
    Donor_ID       = merged$Donor_ID,
    Variant_Caller = merged$Variant_Caller_Pangenome,
    Delta_Recall    = merged$Recall_Pangenome - merged$Recall_Linear,
    Delta_Precision = merged$Precision_Pangenome - merged$Precision_Linear,
    Delta_F1_Score  = merged$F1_Score_Pangenome - merged$F1_Score_Linear
  )
  
  return(result)
}
```

# Calculate delta pangenome - linear
```{r}
delta_strelka <- delta_diff(strelka)
delta_somatic <- delta_diff(somatic)
delta_mutect <- delta_diff(mutect)
```

# Combine data
```{r}
combined <- rbind(delta_strelka, delta_somatic, delta_mutect)
combined$Variant_Caller <- factor(
  combined$Variant_Caller,
  levels = c("SomaticSniper", "Strelka", "Mutect2")
)
```

# Plotting
```{r}
combined_long <- data.frame(
  Variant_Caller = rep(combined$Variant_Caller, times = 3),
  Metric = rep(c("Delta_F1_Score", "Delta_Precision", "Delta_Recall"), each = nrow(combined)),
  Value  = c(combined$Delta_F1_Score, combined$Delta_Precision, combined$Delta_Recall)
)

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.8)
jitterdodge <- position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8)

set.seed(1)
plot_output <- ggplot(combined_long, aes(Metric, Value, fill=Variant_Caller)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf, xmax = 1.5,      
    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,   
    alpha = 0.2,                
    fill = "grey") +
  stat_boxplot(
    geom = "errorbar", 
    width = 0.3, 
    color = "black", 
    size = 0.6,
    position = dodge) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, 
    linetype = "solid", 
    color = "black", 
    size = 1) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 1, 
    color = "black", 
    size = 0.6, 
    position = dodge) +
  labs(
    # title = plot_title, 
    x = element_blank(), 
    y = expression(paste(Delta, " Metric Percentage (%)"))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "Delta_F1_Score" = "F1 Score",
    "Delta_Precision" = "Precision",
    "Delta_Recall" = "Recall"))  +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-65, 65),                  
    breaks = seq(-100, 100, 20)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = colors,
    name = "Variant Caller",
    labels = c(
        "SomaticSniper" = "Somatic Sniper",
        "Strelka" = "Strelka",
        "Mutect2" = "Mutect2")) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = black_colors,
    name = "Variant Caller",
    labels = c(
        "SomaticSniper" = "Somatic Sniper",
        "Strelka" = "Strelka",
        "Mutect2" = "Mutect2")) +
  geom_jitter(
    size = 2,
    shape = 21,
    aes(color = Variant_Caller),
    fill = NA,
    alpha = 0.9,
    position = jitterdodge) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Helvetica"),
    legend.position = "none",
    # legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.9, 0.85),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    # panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#F0F0F0"),
    # panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(color = "#F0F0F0"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), 
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.line.y.left   = element_line(color = "black"),
    # plot.margin = margin(5.5, 50, 5.5, 5.5)
    ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.5, y = Inf,
    label = "Pangenome - Linear",
    size = 7,
    color = "black",
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 2,
    family = "Helvetica") +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(1.5, 2.5), 
    linetype = "dashed", 
    color = "grey", 
    size = 0.6)

plot_output
```

```{r}
ggsave("./plot/figure1_variant_caller_boxplot_delta_pangenome_linear.pdf", plot_output, width = 13, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
